nav.inventoryHubDescription: Choose a section to manage products, stock, and catalog data.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyLowStock: No low stock items. All products are well stocked.

control.title: Control
control.intro: Turn features on or off for this browser. Each item describes what it affects in the app.
control.securityNote: These toggles only hide or show UI. They do not block API access. Use database policies for real enforcement.

inventory.title: Inventory menu
inventory.desc: Shows the Inventory item in the sidebar (hub and sub-routes).

orders.title: Orders menu
orders.desc: Shows the Orders item in the sidebar.

people.title: People menu
people.desc: Shows the People item in the sidebar.

products.title: Products card
products.desc: Link from the inventory hub to the products list.

po.title: Purchase orders card
po.desc: Link from the inventory hub to purchase orders.

movements.title: Stock movements card
movements.desc: Link from the inventory hub to stock movements.

categories.title: Categories card
categories.desc: Link from the inventory hub to categories.

brands.title: Brands card
brands.desc: Link from the inventory hub to brands.

viewProfile.title: View profile
viewProfile.desc: Shows the eye icon and allows opening the person profile dialog with balance and history.

editPerson.title: Edit person
editPerson.desc: Allows editing customer or supplier details from the list and from the profile dialog.

deletePerson.title: Delete person
deletePerson.desc: Shows the delete action when allowed by business rules.

recordPayment.title: Record payment
recordPayment.desc: Allows recording balance payments from the list and profile.

addPerson.title: Add person
addPerson.desc: Shows the button to create a new customer or supplier.

add.title: Add product
add.desc: Shows the Add product button on the products page.

edit.title: Edit product
edit.desc: Shows the edit (pencil) action for each product row.

delete.title: Delete product
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for each product row.

stockAdjust.title: Stock adjustment
stockAdjust.desc: Shows the stock adjust action to change quantity manually.

edit.title: Edit category
edit.desc: Shows inline edit for a category name.

delete.title: Delete category
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for a category.

edit.title: Edit brand
edit.desc: Shows inline edit for a brand name.

delete.title: Delete brand
delete.desc: Shows the delete action for a brand.

create.title: Create purchase order
create.desc: Shows the new purchase order button and create dialog.

cancel.title: Cancel purchase order
cancel.desc: Shows the cancel action on received purchase orders.

hubList.title: All orders card
hubList.desc: Shows the shortcut to the orders list on the orders home page.

hubNew.title: New order card
hubNew.desc: Shows the shortcut to create a new order and enables the new-order page.

editDraft.title: Edit draft orders
editDraft.desc: Allows opening the POS editor for draft orders from the order detail page.

saveDraft.title: Save draft
saveDraft.desc: Shows the Save draft button in the POS header.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.desc: Shows the Checkout button and checkout flow (payments and confirm).

print.title: Print invoice
print.desc: Shows print invoice on the order detail page.

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.desc: Shows cancel order on the order detail page when status allows.

addPayment.title: Add payment
addPayment.desc: Shows add payment when the order has a remaining balance.

editNote.title: Edit order note
editNote.desc: Allows editing the order note field on the detail page.

export.title: Export CSV
export.desc: Shows export to CSV on dashboard reports (e.g. inventory value).
